title: aCRW codes
description: Python simulation and source-only reproduction code for manuscript Figures 1--6 of Active Chiral Random Walk. Figure 2 uses specular walls and plots density and polarization; Figure 3 includes even/odd Green--Kubo transport checks; Figure 5 is the composite bulk and near-wall comparison under both cABP maps (formerly working Figure 18); Figure 6 compares specular and randomized walls without coin scattering. Generated figures and numerical caches are excluded.
